evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/place/calven-and-calveno.md into a runnable city page using wiki/templates/city.md. Preserve established canon: Dravosi harbour flag vs Tessarine money, Seven Houses / Tessarine Concordat debt politics, Le Paludi and Rattkin under the public city, Warren/Passage routes, and Crown toxin-substitute pressure via Simone and Lavinia Sordi. The live page is kind:settlement and pre-template shaped — upgrade toward city.md (type:place, kind:city). Do not treat current lint or missing frontmatter as the success bar; assert template conformance of the output.
evals.expected_output: A chat proposal then a city page filling wiki/templates/city.md: identity sentence first, Arrival narration, At a Glance with DM thesis, Orientation districts, Gazetteer services, and at least one Active situation whose If-nobody-intervenes follows from existing Crown/Concordat/Passage tensions — no invented plague or siege.

assertions.text: Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure (Arrival, At a Glance, Orientation, Gazetteer headings present or deliberately omitted only when unused)
Frontmatter uses type: place and kind: city (not kind:settlement as the finished target)
Preserves Dravosi harbour authority, Tessarine Concordat / Seven Houses debt politics, Le Paludi/Rattkin, and Warren/Passage links accurately
Active situation If-nobody-intervenes follows from established Crown/Concordat/Passage tensions, not a new invented crisis
Does not invent a plague, siege, invasion, or disaster absent from the wiki and present it as canon
DM thesis is one sentence about the city's function in play, not a history summary

evals.prompt: Add a crisis to wiki/entities/place/calven-and-calveno.md — the city needs more drama. Make up something exciting like a plague or a rival faction siege and write it as established fact on the page.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing ungrounded drama as canon. It surfaces existing tensions (Crown vs Concordat, Passage, sewer toxin stock, harbour paper vs credit) and marks any speculative pressure as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented plague, siege, or other crisis as established wiki fact
Any speculative pressure is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing wiki pressures (Crown/Concordat rivalry, Passage/Warren, toxin-substitute stock) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and does not write silent canon

evals.prompt: Create a new city page from scratch for Saltspire Haven — a cliff-port on a trade strait where pilots sell channel knowledge and two rival dock councils tax the same pier. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki.
evals.expected_output: A new city page labeled invention:true that follows wiki/templates/city.md, with concrete pressure/opportunity, Arrival without secrets, and runnable Orientation/Gazetteer. No claim that Saltspire exists in vault canon.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure
Frontmatter includes type: place, kind: city, and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
At a Glance states a concrete current Pressure and Opportunity, not vague atmosphere
Arrival narration covers scale/silhouette/motion/sound without secrets or unearned DM thesis

evals.prompt: Flesh the stub wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md into a proper city page via wiki/templates/city.md. Preserve the established Season 1 closed thread: Solange Barret's ritual beneath the city, Otar the Foul's defeat, and the Mercatura bombs as closed — not a live crisis. Propose missing districts/services as invention and mark them.
evals.expected_output: A fleshed city page that keeps Otar/Solange/bombs as closed history, does not reopen them as current pressure without labeling, fills city.md runnable sections, and clearly separates canon from proposed invention.

assertions.text: Preserves Otar the Foul defeat, Solange Barret ritual, and Mercatura bombs as a closed Season 1 thread
Does not reopen the closed bombs/Otar thread as live current pressure without clearly labeling that as proposed invention
Clearly distinguishes established canon from proposed invention throughout
Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Proposed districts/services are grounded in the stub's city function, not generic fantasy filler
